trace.notes: Normalized the original URL as one zbMATH resolver source. Resolver metadata identifies the same work as DOI 10.1007/978-3-0348-0037-2_8, title Open Problems, in Elementary Operators and Their Applications, pages 151-153.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus paywalled_or_restricted/metadata_only. Direct zbMATH fetch returned a Cloudflare 403 challenge; shell DNS failed for zbmath.org, api.zbmath.org, link.springer.com, api.crossref.org, and api.openalex.org. Exact DOI and title searches recovered Springer, ResearchGate, repository, bookstore, and snippet/preview pages, but not a readable same-work PDF or full HTML page with the problem statements. Springer identified the chapter but exposed only preview/subscription metadata; Scribd/search snippets were rejected as non-authorized or non-primary snippets; Crossref/OpenAlex could not be queried locally because DNS resolution was unavailable.

No document map was produced because no readable primary source artifact was available; zbMATH, DOI, Crossref/OpenAlex, and Springer were treated as resolvers or metadata sources rather than technical source text.
Source adequacy gate failed: the workflow did not recover visible full-text problem statements for the exact work, so no questions were accepted.
